game.title: Chupan Bazi
game.description: A traditional game played by shepherds using their staffs to toss stones or sheep vertebrae, testing accuracy and distance control while tending flocks.
howToPlay: Step 1: Shepherds mark a target line on the ground at varying distances.
Step 2: Players take turns placing a stone on the end of their staff.
Step 3: With a flicking motion, they launch the stone toward the target line.
Step 4: Points are awarded based on how close the stone lands to the line.
Step 5: Players can also compete to see who can launch stones the farthest.
Step 6: The game helps pass time during long hours of herding.
Step 7: Variations include aiming at specific targets like rocks or trees.
Step 8: Skilled players develop consistent and accurate throwing techniques.
Step 9: The game requires no special preparation and uses available materials.
Step 10: Winners are recognized among the herding community.
